data.text: Yes, John. I’ll pledge 12.5 tons’ worth directly to the clinic once we verify the need, with our combined catch capped at 50 tons. That protects both our neighbors’ care and the lake our families depend on. Before making a 60-ton exception, let’s confirm that the missing $10,000 can’t come from donations or a short advance—and agree on individual shares of next month’s 30-ton recovery cap. Luke, can you connect us with the clinic now so we can settle this before anyone fishes?
